create_transformer_model: create a PyTorch Transformer model with configurable encoder and decoder layers
build_transformer_encoder: build a TransformerEncoder stack of N encoder layers with self-attention and feedforward networks
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder stack of N decoder layers with self-attention, cross-attention, and feedforward networks
test_transformer_encoder_layer: test the TransformerEncoderLayer with self-attention and feedforward network blocks
review_transformer_decoder_layer: review the TransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, multi-head attention, and feedforward network blocks
